name: Adobe Sensei
tagline: Adobe Sensei is the AI and machine learning platform embedded across Adobe's entire product suite — Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, InDesign, and more. It powers features like Generative Fill, Neural Filters, Auto Reframe, Speech to Text, and Content-Aware Fill that have become standard tools in creative workflows. With Sensei, Adobe has integrated generative AI into the tools professionals already use rather than building a separate product, making it the AI platform with the most working creative professionals as daily users.
